BiblicalUsage: Kephath means to fetter, to bind: Daniel 3:20 says Nebuchadnezzar commanded the most mighty men to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, and cast them into the burning fiery furnace. Daniel 3:21 says these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats. Daniel 3:23 says they fell down bound into the midst of the fire. Daniel 3:24 says the king was astonied, and asked, did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the binding is the point: they went in bound, and the king saw four men walking loose. I hold that the fire burns the ropes, not the righteous, and the fourth man in the furnace is the one who was never bound at all.
RelatedPeople: Daniel; Shadrach; Meshach; Abednego; King Nebuchadnezzar
